title: Sweet Chilli Mushroom Omelette
ingredients: 1 large flat mushroom, very finely sliced
steps: Fry mushroom slices over high heat in cooking spray for 2–3 minutes. Stir in sweet chilli sauce and remove from heat.
Beat eggs with salt and pepper.
Spray a medium nonstick frying pan and place over high heat. Pour in the egg.
As edges set, bring cooked edges into the middle; tilt pan to swirl runny egg to edges.
Keep heat low until no liquid egg remains on top.
Spoon mushroom mixture over one half; fold the other half over.
Slide onto a plate and scatter with parsley.
notes: A good nonstick frying pan is essential.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
